name: wayground-clone
description: Wayground (formerly Quizizz) clone: assessments, live & homework games, reports, AI with Gemma

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && node scripts/db.mjs ensure && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: node scripts/db.mjs ensure && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: node scripts/db.mjs ensure && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server start
